title: Quick Fried Dutch Marzipan Fritters
description: Savory Dutch fritters featuring marzipan, perfect for a low-carb brunch, cooked to a fluffy perfection in a fondue pot. These fritters are a twist on traditional Dutch cuisine.
instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together with a fork.
Add the grated cheese, chopped parsley, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder to the bowl and mix well.
Crumble the marzipan into small pieces and add it to the bowl, mixing until just combined.
Heat the cooking oil in a fondue pot to 375 degrees.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the marzipan mixture into the hot oil, being careful not to overcrowd the pot.
Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and puffed up.
Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve the fritters hot and enjoy.
Repeat the frying process with the remaining marzipan mixture.
Keep the fritters warm in a low oven while frying the remaining batches.
